text: I really appreciate that you're given the option to go through the tutorial or start right away! The tutorial didn't take long and ads aren't pushed in my face constantly. I'd rather not have to wait for the app to load though. I also didn't receive coins for inviting a friend. The app looks nice but I don't think it's for me
author: lacuna
developer_reply: Thank you for your honest review, we appreciate your feedback. 😊We're sorry to hear the coins for inviting a friend weren't credited to you – thank you for letting us know, we'll look into this issue. Could you please send us your ID (found in settings) to ideas@islegrowapp.com? We'd be happy to sort this out for you.

text: AuDHD Adult. I've tried so many habit apps. the RPGs and jar aren't interactive enough, the pets are too overwhelming with features, civ sims with too much management and IAP. this looks like a gentle middle ground of all of those, with easy task making, wellness presets, simple journaling, and visible, interactive progress. the artwork and animation is gorgeous, the store screenshots don't do it justice. I'll have to see when paywalls stop me or if i get bored, but I'm hoping this is the one.
author: Bevveh
developer_reply: Thank you so much for this wonderful review — it especially made our day. You captured exactly what we care most about, and we're so glad IsleGrow is helping you. Thank you again, and we hope the app keeps supporting you well into the future. 😊

text: Perfect app. If you really decided to change some things in your life, this gamification based app is a great helper. Slowly building things and snowball effect is something that everybody should know.
author: Mutlucan GİRGİN
developer_reply: Thank you so much for the wonderful review. 😊

text: Hi!! I'm obsessed with this app! I would love it if you could add a Home Screen widget to track my daily streak. Maybe a little flame icon with the streak count inside? Streaks are so helpful for staying consistent and making sure I check off my habits every day. I really hope you consider this, and maybe even add more widgets in the future! ♥️
author: Mati Fernandez
developer_reply: Hi there, thanks so much for the lovely review! And we have good news for you — we're already hard at work on a widget (lots of users have been asking for one!). Stay tuned — it should be landing in the app soon! Thanks for using our app! ♥️

text: Moc příjemný úkolníček, skvělej na pravidelný činnosti, výborná grafika. Trochu škoda, že nejde alespoň odškrtávat ofline, ale člověk zas tak často mimo signál není. Bylo by taky super moci nahlédnout na zítřejší den (nebo na přehledný týdenní kalendář), aby člověk věděl, co ho čeká. SUPER, že lze odškrtnout i druhý den, pokud splníte, ale do půlnoci nezapíšete.
author: Pavel Martínek
developer_reply: Dobrý den, mockrát děkujeme za Vaši milou recenzi. 😊 Na tento problém jsme při testování nenarazili, proto budeme velmi rádi, když nám na mail ideas@islegrowapp.com pošlete video. Ještě jednou děkujeme za Vaši ochotu, chybku se pokusíme odstranit co nejdříve. 😊

text: This is not a free app. It is $40 a month.

We’re sorry, but it seems there may be a misunderstanding.
The app is free to use in its basic version. The PRO version is paid, but the price you mentioned applies to an annual subscription, not a monthly fee.
